{{Quote|Bring the Water of Life.|Mother Talzin|<ref name="Nightsisters (episode)">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Water of Life''', or the '''waters of life''', was an employment of [[Spirit ichor/Legends|spirit ichor]] that was used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in their [[Dathomir Magic|spells]]. It was used primarily for healing purposes but could also be used to render someone near-invisible.
